paper.title_en: Higher-spin charges and the $L_Λ w_{1 + \infty}$ algebra in (A)dS$_4$
paper.abstract_en: We consider $(3+1)$-dimensional asymptotically locally (anti-)de Sitter ((A)dS$_4$) spacetimes with boundary conditions allowing for gravitational flux. We construct an infinite tower of higher-spin charges as perturbative solutions in the cosmological constant $Λ$ to a hierarchy of evolution equations resulting from an asymptotic expansion of the Einstein equations. We show that these charges canonically realize the $Λ$-deformed $w_{1+\infty}$ algebra ($L_Λ w_{1+\infty}$) on a restricted gravitational phase space, thereby extending the higher-spin symmetry structure of asymptotically flat spacetimes to asymptotically (A)dS spacetimes. We further construct the curved-space counterparts of conformally soft gravitons directly in terms of spacetime data. We show that they are primaries with respect to an $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})$ subalgebra of the (A)dS$_4$ isometry algebra and that their Poisson brackets with the quadratic higher-spin charges reproduce the $Λ$-deformed celestial operator product expansion proposed by Taylor and Zhu. Our results establish the bulk gravitational origin of the $L_Λw_{1+\infty}$ symmetry and extend the celestial bulk-boundary dictionary to asymptotically (A)dS$_4$ gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在(A)dS4渐近时空中构造了高自旋荷并实现Λ变形w1+∞代数，建立引力起源和天体全息对应，理论上具有重要意义。
decision.title_zh: 高自旋荷与(A)dS4中的L_Λ w_{1+∞}代数
decision.abstract_zh: 我们考虑(3+1)维渐近局部(反)德西特((A)dS4)时空，其边界条件允许引力通量。我们将高自旋荷构造为宇宙学常数Λ中的微扰解，这些解来自爱因斯坦方程渐近展开所产生的演化方程层级。我们证明这些荷在受限引力相空间上正则实现Λ变形的w_{1+∞}代数(L_Λw_{1+∞})，从而将渐近平直时空的高自旋对称结构扩展到渐近(A)dS时空。我们进一步直接以时空数据构造共形软引力子的弯曲空间对应物。我们证明它们是(A)dS4等距代数sl(2,R)子代数的初级场，并且它们与二次高自旋荷的泊松括号再现了Taylor和Zhu提出的Λ变形天体算子乘积展开。我们的结果确立了L_Λw_{1+∞}对称性的体引力起源，并将天体体-边界词典扩展到渐近(A)dS4引力。
